name: io.github.stablevoy/stablevoy-mcp
description: USDT and USDC invoices, payment totals and docs for your Stablevoy stores. Keys cannot move funds.

environmentVariables.name: STABLEVOY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A store API key (sk_live_...) for one store. Leave unset to use the keys of npx stablevoy-mcp login; with neither, the store tools answer not_signed_in and the documentation works.

environmentVariables.name: STABLEVOY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true leaves create_invoice and cancel_invoice out: read tools only.
